basic_details.job_title: BBAU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Admin cum Data Entry Operator, Field Investigator Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Food and Nutrition, School of Home Science, Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University (BBAU), Lucknow, needs one Admin cum Data Entry Operator and one Field Investigator cum Mapper for the research project "Learning Initiative for Vitamin A and D Fortification Programming". Both posts are purely temporary, run for 6 months and carry emoluments of Rs. 35,000/-. The Admin cum Data Entry Operator needs a graduate degree with 3 years of administration/purchase experience, and the Field Investigator cum Mapper needs a GIS-related Master's degree, or a graduate degree with a PG Diploma

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the prescribed format attached with the notice as Annexure A (Application Form).
In the form, give the post applied for, personal details, educational qualifications, experience, training details and any additional information, then sign the declaration.
Attach photocopies of marksheets and degree/certificates, and the certificates for any experience claimed.

Upload your details, with all relevant information and supporting documents/certificates, through the Google Form of your post: Admin cum Data Entry Operator – https://forms.gle/3B1NyGbuBDsf8inP6; Field Investigator cum Mapper – https://forms.gle/ujrtJr8bxg5a8GXf9.
Complete the submission by 21 November 2026, the last date of submission of application.
Original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates.
Photocopies of marksheets and degree/certificates, and experience certificates.
important_instructions: No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. If any information in the application is found false, incomplete or incorrect, the candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated. The application form asks applicants to state the number of sheets attached with it.

content_sections.heading: About BBAU
content_sections.text: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University is a Central University located at Vidya Vihar, Rae Bareli Road, Lucknow-226025. These posts are in its Department of Food and Nutrition, School of Home Science, under the research project "Learning Initiative for Vitamin A and D Fortification Programming", run in collaboration with PGIMER, Chandigarh; BBAU, Lucknow; ICMR-NIN, Hyderabad; FSSAI, New Delhi; and SJRI, Bengaluru, for the session 2026-27. The notice is issued by Prof. Neetu Singh, Co-PI.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice offers 2 project positions in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the two posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable qualification: Undergraduate Diploma in Computer Applications / Diploma in Financial Accounting. Prior experience in data entry. Experience in handling the GeM Portal. Knowledge of GFR and CCS (CCA) Rules. Experience in office administration or project documentation. Working knowledge of English and Hindi. Essential qualification: (i) Master's degree in Remote Sensing & GIS, Geoinformatics, Geography, Environmental Science, or an allied field from a recognized university/institution, with a minimum of one (01) year of relevant experience. OR (ii) Graduate degree in Geography, Environmental Science, Remote Sensing & GIS, Geoinformatics or an allied field from a recognized university/institution, along with a Postgraduate Diploma in GIS and Remote Sensing, and a minimum of one (01) year of relevant experience. Desirable qualification/skills: Experience in community-based/household surveys. Experience in GPS/GNSS and mobile-based data collection. Familiarity with ArcGIS/QGIS and GIS mapping/geotagging. Knowledge of the local language and community. Willingness to travel for fieldwork. The application form notes that experience without certificates shall not be considered. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility of each post, candidates can check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: A graduate degree from a recognized university/institution, proficiency in MS Office (Word and Excel), and good typing speed (English 30 wpm).
rows.experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in administration/purchase.

rows.essential_qualification: Option (i) or option (ii), given in full below the table.
rows.experience: Minimum one (01) year of relevant experience (in both options).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each post carries emoluments of Rs. 35,000/- and a duration of 6 months. The positions are purely temporary and will be governed as per the guidelines of the project. The terms and conditions of the appointment shall be governed by the rules and regulations of BBAU, Lucknow, and PGIMER, Chandigarh. The notice does not mention HRA or any other allowance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBAU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed format attached with the notice as Annexure A (Application Form). In the form, give the post applied for, personal details, educational qualifications, experience, training details and any additional information, then sign the declaration. Attach photocopies of marksheets and degree/certificates, and the certificates for any experience claimed. Upload your details, with all relevant information and supporting documents/certificates, through the Google Form of your post: Admin cum Data Entry Operator – https://forms.gle/3B1NyGbuBDsf8inP6 ; Field Investigator cum Mapper – https://forms.gle/ujrtJr8bxg5a8GXf9 . Complete the submission by 21 November 2026, the last date of submission of application. Documents named in the notice: Filled application form (Annexure A). Original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates. Recent CV. Two passport-size photographs. Photocopies of marksheets and degree/certificates, and experience certificates.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice is headed "Walk-in-Interview". Eligible candidates shall appear for the interview in hybrid mode, bringing the filled application form, original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates, and a recent CV with two passport-size photographs. The interview date, time and venue are not specified in the notice. The decision of the selection committee shall be final.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. If any information in the application is found false, incomplete or incorrect, the candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated. The application form asks applicants to state the number of sheets attached with it.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BBAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Admin cum Data Entry Operator and 1 Field Investigator cum Mapper.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BBAU project posts?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of application is 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the BBAU Admin cum Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: A graduate degree from a recognized university/institution, proficiency in MS Office (Word and Excel), good typing speed (English 30 wpm) and minimum 3 years of experience in administration/purchase.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Field Investigator cum Mapper post?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Remote Sensing & GIS, Geoinformatics, Geography, Environmental Science or an allied field, or a graduate degree in these fields with a Postgraduate Diploma in GIS and Remote Sensing, in both cases with minimum one (01) year of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for BBAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Both the Admin cum Data Entry Operator and the Field Investigator cum Mapper posts carry emoluments of Rs. 35,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the BBAU project posts?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure A application form and upload your details with supporting documents through the Google Form link of your post by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates shall appear for an interview in hybrid mode, and the decision of the selection committee shall be final.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BBAU project job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary for 6 months and will be governed as per the guidelines of the project.

faq.question: Q9. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: The filled application form, original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates, and a recent CV with two passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
